bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Bears have ruled out starting quarterback Caleb Williams for Sunday's Week 4 matchup against the New York Jets due to a hamstring injury, with backup Tyson Bagent expected to get the start according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. Chicago Bears backup quarterback Tyson Bagent is expected to start Sunday against the New York Jets, according to a report from NFL Network's Ian Rapoport, and will be making his fifth NFL start and first since 2023.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are preparing for their Week 4 "Sunday Night Football" matchup against the Carolina Panthers, with head coach Dan Campbell confirming the team made a deep pursuit of cornerback Joey Porter Jr. before losing out to the Dallas Cowboys, while also noting that safety Brian Branch has been praised in a way that gives fans hope for his return .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest story from the last 24 hours is the Packers placing defensive tackle Warren Brinson on injured reserve, just days after he suffered a groin injury during his first practice back from a calf issue, which will sideline him for at least four games. The Green Bay Packers placed defensive tackle Warren Brinson on injured reserve Saturday, three days after he hurt his groin in his first practice back from a calf injury, with general manager Brian Gutekunst announcing the move one day before Green Bay's Week 4 game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: Star wide receiver Justin Jefferson has been ruled out for Sunday's Week 4 matchup against the Miami Dolphins due to a sprained right ankle suffered against Tampa Bay, with coach Kevin O'Connell noting "He's definitely feeling better." With Jefferson sidelined, the 3-0 Vikings will lean on their supporting cast and a defense led by Brian Flores as Kyler Murray looks to keep Minnesota's hot start alive.
